excluded.name: 台湾省
excluded.reason: Taiwan uses a separate county/city dataset in Pando.

notes: 333 prefecture-level divisions plus 4 directly governed municipalities, 32 province-direct county units, and Hong Kong/Macao as whole special administrative regions, for complete source coverage.
Taiwan source unit CN-710000 is excluded because Pando uses a separate Taiwan county/city dataset. Other claimed offshore-island overlaps must be resolved against that separate source at integration.
Native Chinese names are preserved. English names are source romanizations, not a claim of standardized English spelling.

CN-460300 Sansha contains source reef/shoal outlines, including submerged reefs; these are not uniformly dry-land coastlines. Preserve the raw source but intersect with an independent physical-land mask before cartographic display.
Source geometries are cartographic approximations; 2023 source-era counts must not be presented as current official counts.
Geometry remains unprojected longitude/latitude (WGS84-like source coordinates); no decorative insets or marine dashed claim lines are introduced.
